validated_targets.specific_model_name: NIH3T3, human melanoma, ovarian carcinoma, and mesothelioma cell lines

title: Expression of the bacterial nitroreductase enzyme in mammalian cells renders them selectively sensitive to killing by the prodrug CB1954.

evidence_summary: Treatment of G12 cells with crocidolite increased gpt mutation frequency; iron chelation with desferrioxamine B prevented this increase, and nitric oxide donor synergistically enhanced mutation frequency, validating iron and nitric oxide roles in asbestos-induced mutagenesis.
title: Participation of iron and nitric oxide in the mutagenicity of asbestos in hgprt-, gpt+ Chinese hamster V79 cells.

evidence_summary: Asbestos treatment induced AP-endonuclease mRNA, protein, and enzyme activity in rat pleural mesothelial cells in a dose-dependent manner, verified by expression analysis, protein measurement, enzyme assay, and confocal microscopy.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Crocidolite asbestos at 1.25 and 2.5 microg/cm2 significantly increased AP-endonuclease mRNA, protein levels, and enzyme activity in rat pleural mesothelial cells, with nuclear and mitochondrial localization confirmed by confocal microscopy.

title: Asbestos increases mammalian AP-endonuclease gene expression, protein levels, and enzyme activity in mesothelial cells.

evidence_summary: Injection of neoplastic rat mesothelioma cells into nude mice resulted in tumors with 99% trisomy 1 frequency, confirming selective growth advantage in vivo; in vitro passage of mesothelial cell lines also showed progressive increase in trisomy 1.
validation_methods: in vivo xenograft model in nude mice
title: Trisomy of rat chromosome 1 associated with mesothelial cell transformation.
